submitted.rationale: Of the three EQE measurements, index 13 (Ni0.58Sb0.42) gave the highest value, 0.236%. The Sb-rich NiSb2O6 composition (index 21) measured 0.005% and the Ni-rich index 7 measured 0.068%, so merit appears to peak in the middle of the composition line, near the NiSbO3/Ni2Sb2O7 region (Ni:Sb about 1:1).

rejected.reason: The trirutile NiSb2O6 composition measured an EQE of only 0.0048%.
The Ni-rich composition measured 0.068% EQE, lower than index 13.
